weakness: Shared tag management lets marketing teams in all three divisions publish scripts to payment pages without security review or page owner approval; the SOC cannot disable a tag

milestones: 2026-10-15 payment pages removed from "all pages" containers; 2026-11-15 inventories for all four pages; 2026-11-30 page owner approval enforced and SOC disable role live

weakness: Payment page change and tamper detection covers the retail web checkout only, and alerts go to a marketing mailbox reviewed weekly
remediation_plan: Extend monitoring to the app web checkout view, the wholesale portal payment page, and the cardholder portal payment page; route alerts to the SIEM with a 1-hour triage target (POL-03 4.4)
milestones: 2026-10-31 alerts routed to the SOC; 2026-11-30 all four pages monitored

remediation_plan: Isolated Rewards Card payment frame operated by Financial Services on its own domain; until then, joint evaluation of the field and inclusion in payment page monitoring and the Financial Services data inventory

owner: Financial Services CISO with the Grocery Retail chief digital officer

weakness: Critical patches at the 46 acquired stores average 74 days; lane firmware two releases behind
remediation_plan: Move acquired stores to the group patch cycle; firmware update during the segmentation visits
milestones: 2026-11-30 patch timeline met for two cycles

weakness: Acquired store controllers and the legacy store gateway not in the SIEM; logs reviewed weekly by hand
source: P07 assessment (AU-06a.; SI-04c.01); P03 G-044, G-046
remediation_plan: Onboard controller and gateway logs to the SIEM with the CDE use cases; daily automated review
milestones: 2026-11-15 controllers in the ROC sample onboarded; 2026-12-31 all 46 stores and the gateway onboarded

source: P07 assessment (AC-02f.[01]; AC-02j.; IA-05f.; IA-05g.); P03 G-037
remediation_plan: Vault all switch and gateway application accounts with automatic rotation; remove secrets from the repository and rotate them; include the accounts in the semi-annual access review
milestones: 2026-10-15 repository secrets removed and rotated; 2026-12-31 all 41 accounts vaulted

weakness: About 41,000 opted-out cardholders not suppressed from card-derived CDP audiences; no record of when the 1022.21(c)(1) exception is used
